# Script to plot the accumulation of synonymous mutations per time for neo-sex chromosomes

## 1. Configuration
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "C:/Users/Julia/Desktop/IRT3")

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel) 
library(dplyr)
```

## 2. Data
```{r}
data <- read_excel("C:/Users/Julia/Desktop/IRT3/NR_dataset.xlsx", sheet=1, col_name=TRUE )


#transforming data into numeric values

data$neo <- as.numeric(data$neo)
data$filtered_neo <- as.numeric(data$filtered_neo)
data$ancestral <- as.numeric(data$ancestral)
data$filtered_ancestral <- as.numeric(data$filtered_ancestral)
data$autosomal <- as.numeric(data$autosomal)
data$filtered_autosomal <- as.numeric(data$filtered_autosomal)
data$clootl <- as.numeric(data$clootl)
data$other <- as.numeric(data$other)


#filtering out Columbiformes for now
data_filtered <- data %>%
  filter(clade != "Columbiformes")

```

## 3. Plot Neo
```{r}
ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x=clootl, y=neo, color=clade)) +
  geom_point(size=3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x= "clade age clootl (MYA)", y= "dS neo-sex genes") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 70), breaks = seq(0, 70, by =5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.09), breaks = seq(0,0.09, by=0.01)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label=clade), box.padding = 0.2, max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color =NA, show.legend=FALSE) #avoids overlapping when adding the label on the geom_point
```


## Save plot
```{r}
ggsave("dS_neo_distribution.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
```


## 4. Plot filtered Neo
```{r}
ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x=clootl, y=filtered_neo, color=clade)) +
  geom_point(size=3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x= "clade age clootl (MYA)", y= "dS neo-sex genes") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 70), breaks = seq(0, 70, by =5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.09), breaks = seq(0,0.09, by=0.01)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label=clade), box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color =NA, show.legend=FALSE)
```

## Save plot
```{r}
ggsave("dS_filtered_neo_distribution.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
```

## 5. Eocene hypothesis for Sylvioidea 
```{r}
ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x=other, y=neo, color=clade)) +
  geom_point(size=3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x= "clade age", y= "neo dS rate") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 70), breaks = seq(0, 70, by =5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.09), breaks = seq(0,0.09, by=0.01)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label=clade), box.padding = 0.2, max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color =NA, show.legend=FALSE) #avoids overlapping when adding the label on the geom_point 

```

## Save plot
```{r}
ggsave("dS_eocene_Sylvioidea_distribution.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
```
